messages:
Olivia: Quick check-in on Argonaut reserved pool — saw high saturation overnight.
Maria: 7d snapshot:
- GPU hours: 2,340 (+28% w/w)
- Peak saturation: 92% (3 days >85%)
- Avg queue depth: 14 (p95 37)
- p95 start latency: 420ms
- Errors: 0.9% (primarily OOM on long seq)
- Commit coverage: 112% (overage est $6.4k)
Ajay: Noting correlation with nightly batch + midday interactive spikes.
Tyler: OOMs traced to 65B quantized on seq_len > 4k. Suggest fallback policy.
Maria: CLI I used:
```
ri monitor pool argonaut --since 7d --metrics gpu_hours,sat,queue,errors > argonaut.csv
```
deploy-bot: Dashboard uploaded: https://storage.redwood/argonaut/weekly/2061200000/argonaut-7d.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Olivia: Two risks: renewal churn if overage persists, and interactive UX hit from latency.
Ajay: Short-term fixes:
- enable burst autoscale (+20% for 2h windows) — owner: @Ajay — ETA today EOD
- per-request token cap at 6k with fallback to 13B — owner: @Tyler — ETA 24h
- shift non-urgent batch to off-peak — owner: @Maria — ETA Mon
Tyler: Medium-term: propose +18% reserved commitment for April. Will send cost/benefit.
Maria: I'll drive the enablement demo — Thu 10:00 PDT. Will include queue heatmap + token distribution.
Ajay: I'll prep autoscale snippet and canary plan:
```
autoscale:
  policy: burst
  burst_pct: 20
  window: 2h
  cooldown: 30m
```
Tyler: Adding kernel-fallback flag to serving config for long seqs.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: argonaut-burst-canary @ 2026-03-18T02:30:00Z
Olivia: OK to send a short note to account execs with overage + proposed reserved bump? Will cc Sales.
Maria: +1
Tyler: :thumbsup:
Olivia: I'll post invite + deck once ready. Closing thread — thanks everyone :eyes:
